paper_title: Riding the dark matter wave: Novel limits on general dark photons from LISA Pathfinder
coupling_convention: g_{B-L}, dimensionless gauge coupling as plotted on y-axis
notes: Paper derives world-leading limits on gauged B-L dark photon dark matter using LISA Pathfinder auxiliary channel (SC-TM relative acceleration) April 2016 data. Main solid-line limits are from real data (new limit); forecasts (LPF/LISA) also shown. Fig. 5 y-axis is gauge coupling g_{B-L} = eps_{B-L}*e; Fig. 3/4 show rescaled coupling eps_{B-L}, eps_B. World-leading over 4e-19 eV < m < 3e-17 eV, peak ~5e-18 eV. Exact numerical limit values are not tabulated; the emitted data_points are rough estimates read from the exclusion figure and should be refined against digitized curves. DM density 0.4 GeV/cm^3 assumed. Method insensitive to kinetically-mixed (canonical) dark photon, hence VectorBL not generic DarkPhoton. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.8, 32)) | Vision: Figure 5 of the paper.
